what's the need of vector ?

as worker object gets created and destroyed on each FRU VPD collection.

> as worker object gets created and destroyed on each FRU VPD collection.

NO, currently worker takes care of all the FRUs/threads internally, and so member variables of the Worker class ARE shared among all threads. And that's why we need this vector.

m_fruPreActionResults; is implemented only for collection,As only collection path PreAction has Gpio-presence tag. when base action couldn't read Presence and it is sent to pre-action as Unknown, then only we build this data-table.
deletion will go to the presence- NA.
Also, Deletion is not scope of this story. if required will be done in separate story.

This was stored to handle only UNKNOWN case.
why m_presenceStatus is updated only in this case, is default value NOT_APPLICABLE applied to all other cases ?

This is to handle only UNKNOWN case.
When present , it's present.
When Absent, its absent.
Only for UNKNOWN we need to check further.
I meant to add comment, why returning true but not false here, its significant.
Done
We already have a structure. Why do we need another one? Can't that be re-used?

NO,Base Result has 5 fields but worker APIs need only 2 fields to process.
By creating a separate, minimal struct for each use case, we keep it independent, eliminate confusing 'dead fields[don't need in collection APIs]' and make the code much cleaner to maintain.

The standard, industry-best practice for this situation is, receive the 5-field struct, extract the 2 fields it actually needs, and store them into its own clean 2-field structure to use further.

> NO,Base Result has 5 fields but worker APIs need only 2 fields to process.

Why do you say so? Which tag failed and why is a required information based on which further processing will be done.
The use case is not limited to changes brought in by a commit.

> By creating a separate, minimal struct for each use case, we keep it 
independent, eliminate confusing 'dead fields[don't need in collection 
APIs]' and make the code much cleaner to maintain.

But there is a fine line there, where do you create a balance between code re-usability and independent type based on each use case?
In that case what's you views on having classes defined with multiple members? All the members defined by a class need not be consumed by class(es) instantiating them, should we have separate independent classes with only required members for each use case?

> The standard, industry-best practice for this situation is, receive the 
5-field struct, extract the 2 fields it actually needs, and store them 
into its own clean 2-field structure to use further.

Do you have a data on that which supports your claim that this is an industry standard?
Please remove the blank line between doxygen and member variable.
Done

I will update the doxygen with more details.
This member Is being used in other commit - https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/openpower-vpd-parser/+/91540/
Done
Why a class level variable is required? Just to exchange data between functions?

We have 2 options: Either we receive it as output argument from all consecutive function calls or store it at 1 place which is accessible to other functions.
If we pass data from function to function, there are more traversing.

collectFruVpd need to collect data from < --- parseAndPublishVPD <--parseVpdFile <-- processPreAction

Certainly we have 2 options and that is why the query, why create a class level variable where the result is being consumed just locally or between 2 or 3 APIs in the flow, not required at class level and not use function paramemter?


If you are suggesting that moving data between function is not correct then 
a) Why do we have parameters in any function? Why not create class member for all the information needs to be shared.
b) In which scenarios function parameters should be used as per you?
If there is a requirement to refactor the code then you should have done it a a separate commit. Already the commit is big and these unnecessary noise will just increase the size of patch set.
I will try to make it shorter.
